author: National Geographic
description:
When Montecito, a quiet California beach town, is hit by a monster debris flow in the dead of night, its residents are left fighting for their lives. Through eyewitness testimony and footage of the natural disaster, the Witness to Disaster team reveals how split-second decisions can be the difference between life and death in a destructive mudslide.
